using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.ChatCompletion;
using Xunit;
using Azure.AI.Inference;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel;

public class AzureAIInferenceServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_WithNullChatClient_ResolvesChatClientFromServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var chatClient = new ChatCompletionsClient(new Uri("https://fake-endpoint"), new AzureKeyCredential("fake-key"));
        services.AddSingleton(chatClient);

        // Act
        services.AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion("gpt-35-turbo");

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Assert
        var chatCompletionService = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>("AzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_gpt-35-turbo");
        Assert.NotNull(chatCompletionService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_WithNullChatClient_MissingFromServiceProvider_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
        {
            services.AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion("gpt-35-turbo");
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            _ = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>("AzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_gpt-35-turbo");
        });
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_WithProvidedChatClient_UsesProvidedClient()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var expectedChatClient = new ChatCompletionsClient(new Uri("https://fake-endpoint"), new AzureKeyCredential("fake-key"));

        // Act
        services.AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion("gpt-35-turbo", chatClient: expectedChatClient);

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Assert
        var chatCompletionService = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>("AzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_gpt-35-turbo");
        Assert.NotNull(chatCompletionService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_WithLoggerFactory_UsesLogging()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var chatClient = new ChatCompletionsClient(new Uri("https://fake-endpoint"), new AzureKeyCredential("fake-key"));
        services.AddSingleton(chatClient);
        services.AddLogging();

        // Act
        services.AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion("gpt-35-turbo");

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Assert
        var chatCompletionService = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>("AzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_gpt-35-turbo");
        Assert.NotNull(chatCompletionService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion_WithCustomServiceId_UsesCustomKey()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var chatClient = new ChatCompletionsClient(new Uri("https://fake-endpoint"), new AzureKeyCredential("fake-key"));
        services.AddSingleton(chatClient);

        const string customServiceId = "MyCustomService";

        // Act
        services.AddAzureAIInferenceChatCompletion("gpt-35-turbo", serviceId: customServiceId);

        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

        // Assert
        var chatCompletionService = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IChatCompletionService>(customServiceId);
        Assert.NotNull(chatCompletionService);
    }
}

        Assert.NotNull(chatCompletionService);
